caveat: Retention risk is framed by brands as vendor lock-in: the partner relationships, not the tooling, are what they fear losing.
posthog_label: Anytime withdrawals: payout funnel and failures
source: Brand Persona — Gong (Axi EMEA, ButcherBox, Sonos)
statement: Enterprise brands cite integration complexity, multi-region payment and tax compliance, and fear of losing partner relationships when switching networks.
